title: Cholesterol may disrupt the brain's cleaning system in Alzheimer's disease | New Scientist
description: The glymphatic system flushes toxins out of the brain, but this seems to be disrupted in Alzheimer's disease, and cholesterol may be involved
author: Michael Marshall

title: Digital scents could add a new dimension to virtual worlds | New Scientist
description: It's now possible to convert a handful of smells into electronic signals that can be sent through the internet
author: Jo Marchant

title: Some climate damage is now unavoidable even if we clean up our act | New Scientist
description: With the world looking likely to exceed 1.5°C of warming, the plan is now to reduce our carbon emissions after overshooting the target. What lasting damage will this have?
author: New Scientist

title: Falling sea levels due to El Niño will hit mangroves and corals | New Scientist
description: As sea levels rise in the eastern Pacific, they are falling around Australia and the Coral Triangle, leaving some mangroves and corals high and dry
author: Michael Le Page

title: A single antimatter particle was held in a trap for months | New Scientist
description: After trapping a positron for the first time, physicists plan to use the resulting data to look for answers to one of particle physics’ biggest questions
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: The world's first spinal cord transplant has been performed in Russia | New Scientist
description: A surgeon has told New Scientist they have performed a transplant on someone with a complete spinal cord injury using a piece of spinal cord from a brain-dead donor, but researchers have raised concerns
author: Helen Thomson
